lineage_mis_attribution.when_the_id_collision_was_created: The R370 corpus build (premium_package_factory/templates/build_portfolio.py PACKAGE_MAP) reassigned the P-27-R1 label to the pressure sensor (born R336 CAND-002, promoted as P-25)

novelty_conclusion: UNKNOWN — no prior-art search artifact exists for the self-referencing piezoresistive pressure sensor technology. The R370 claim-level ledger row P-27-R1-C002 ('section 102 screen: SELECTED_REFERENCES_DO_NOT_DISCLOSE_ALL_MAPPED_LIMITATIONS', source 'PatentBear MCP (100+ searches)', span 'R359-R365 patent intelligence for P-27-R1') is a LINEAGE MIS-ATTRIBUTION: the R359-R365 PatentBear searches keyed 'P-27'/'P-27-R1' targeted the then-current P-27 (shape-memory-polymer kink-resistant catheter: 2,014 broad / 515 specific hits, REPAIR) and its metallic-tubing repair candidate — a DIFFERENT invention. This sensor technology entered the portfolio at R336 as CAND-002/P-25 and only acquired the P-27-R1 designation at the R370 corpus rebuild. The ledger citation therefore does NOT cover this technology and must not be read as a novelty screen of it.
